license_classes.AGPL: network copyleft — treat as toxic for SaaS embedding
license_classes.copyleft: GPL family — pattern-only study, linking has obligations

probe_writing.rule: search for code, not concepts; uniqueness beats correctness; 2-5 orthogonal probes per call

results.rate_limit_traps: grep.app 504/429s: the server retries once then degrades to Sourcegraph; an empty result with an error backend_status is a fetch failure, not a negative finding

regex_backend_matrix.github_code_search: literal only, no regex, ~10 req/min, 256-char queries, needs a bare term
regex_backend_matrix.sourcegraph: regex via /.../ probes; pass count:100 style limits server-side

results.response_budget: default calls stay under ~25KB; truncated=true means results were dropped to fit — narrow the query or page with next_cursor
which_tool_when: oss_search_repos: discovery — 'does a tool for X exist?' (README-visible categories)
oss_search_code: vetting — 'who actually implements idiom X?' (implementation details)
oss_repo_tree: file map before guessing any path
oss_fetch_file: byte-exact file read, prefer line_range
oss_fetch_docs: doc search with Source: breadcrumbs
